title: 4D Branding and Behaviour — Идиомы: потребление и внешность

items.idiom: don't judge a book by its cover
items.example: The plain packaging hides great quality — don't judge a book by its cover.
The documentary shows that beauty is only skin deep.
People buy creams just to keep up with the Joneses.
Tourists shop till they drop on the main street.
Luxury brands target people with money to burn.

items.idiom: cost an arm and a leg
items.example: The scientific-looking cream costs an arm and a leg.
Shoppers vote with their wallets for natural products.

items.idiom: put one's money where one's mouth is
items.example: The brand put its money where its mouth is and dropped animal testing.
Customers want to get their money's worth.
A bad week often ends in retail therapy.
She arrived at the presentation dressed to kill.
We spent Saturday window shopping, comparing brands.
At half price the serum was a real steal.
Much of beauty spending is about keeping up appearances.
